verdict.rationale: Bevy ships explicitly versioned releases on crates.io (0.19.1), with per-release migration guides and well-regarded release notes. However, it is pre-1.0 and has breaking changes every release, which is confirmed both by the runtime probe and by users. The evidence never shows a documented deprecation policy or stability guarantee. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, stable or semver-1.0 API guarantees, and deprecation windows before removals.
